verdicts.reason: A: the enlarged quote-mark block is jammed right up against 'PEOPLE'/'LIVE', which reads as a collision. Its small mark also floats loose next to the photo. B uses the same leaderboard structure (photo, quote, author button reading left to right) and leaves clean space between the marks and the text. In both, the decorative marks are blown up far past their size in the original and compete with the quote, the photo is a tiny cropped thumbnail, and the white frame and the original's open whitespace are mostly lost.
